summary: Online scene change detection requires integrating incoming observations to determine which regions have changed relative to a reference scene. We update change beliefs as new images arrive using generalised Bayesian evidence fusion.
takeaways: However, the prior probability of change and evidence models are unknown beforehand, and numerical Bayesian inference can be costly.
We address these challenges by learning offline from automatic edits to a reference 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model.
Together with unchanged reference observations, they provide supervision for learning scene-specific evidence models and estimating the effective pixel prior and response statistics.
